13 — Pricing & Notes
Reduces deposit. Set "On Quote" to Show to display the discount line + valid-through date on the customer quote.
Apply a manufacturer-approved price adjustment
Adjusts the BUILDING price (flows through discount, tax & deposit like a cheaper/dearer building) — unlike the Additional Discount, which reduces the deposit.
Always included as the last two pages of every quote PDF: the Pre-Order Zoning Checklist, then the manufacturer's color chart (CCI or CA).
14 — Contract Information (required when generating contract)
Price already held: this reopened quote keeps its saved price, so Honor Signed Pricing is not applied again.
Reissuing a contract on a signed order (adding colors, etc.): enter the signed contract's Building Subtotal and agreement #. The reprint keeps today's line items, adds one "honoring signed agreement" adjustment row, and the totals, deposit and plans fee recompute to the signed contract's numbers exactly.
These fields appear on the printed contract only. Section 1 (Client Information) fills the city/state/zip portion automatically.
